title: AI Product Manager
summary: AI product managers decide what AI features to build, such as chat assistants or document tools built on large language models, and define how good they must be before launch. They sit between users, engineers, data scientists and business teams, and own the roadmap for those features.
dailyDuties: Talk to users to find problems worth solving with AI
Write PRDs with clear quality bars and test cases
Review evaluation results with data scientists
Prioritise the roadmap against model cost and risk
Track adoption and quality metrics after launch
Explain model limits to sales, legal and support teams

skills.expectation: Shape product features built on LLMs, RAG or agents
Define eval sets and quality bars before launch
Understand how models learn and where they fail
Write PRDs and user stories for AI features
Prioritise the AI roadmap against cost and risk
Find user problems worth solving with AI
Track adoption, quality and cost per use
Align engineering, data science, legal and business teams
Explain model limits and trade-offs in plain words
Handle user data and responsible-AI checks
